notes.subject: bɛna
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb yiqtol lacks an explicit future marker; Bambara needs bɛna

notes.subject: denbaya
notes.rationale: זרע literally 'seed'; rendered as descendants since plants are not in view

notes.subject: יצדקו
notes.rationale: 'be justified' vs 'be righteous'; forensic vs moral reading of the root צדק

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: The verse speaks about all the seed of Israel as the addressee-community

translation: Yawe fɛ, Israyɛl (Izrayɛl) denbaya bɛɛ bɛna tiɲɛ sɔrɔ, ani bɛna a finiw.
